title: Reading Drill — A Workshop for Repairing Laptop Sleeves
description: One short passage, five questions. Recommended time: 8 minutes.

passages.title: A Workshop for Repairing Laptop Sleeves
passages.body:
**A** A reuse group offered to repair fabric laptop sleeves. Volunteers separated cases with torn seams from cases with cracked padding because they required different materials.

**B** Torn seams were often repaired quickly, but some sleeves had been made with very little extra cloth. To avoid making them too narrow, the volunteers added a strip of binding.

**C** People were asked to bring their laptops only when the sleeve had an unusual shape. In other cases a cardboard template was enough to test whether it still fitted.
